It says exploitation of high and critical CVEs roughly doubled, missing MFA was the top initial access vector, ransomware leak posts rose 46.4%, and access brokers sell RDP and VPN access. It also covers state-linked pre-positioning in critical infrastructure, AI-assisted intrusions, ICS malware and extortion groups. Broad overview with no single subject.

hedges: The report says falling average EPSS scores alongside rising exploitation are most plausibly explained by a narrowed prediction window, not by EPSS being wrong.
'Exploited in the wild' is limited to CVSS 7–10 vulnerabilities published in the same calendar year and confirmed exploited within that dataset.
The report states that it 'does not suggest a sudden transformation in attacker intent or sophistication.'
Forum revenue figures are described by the report as 'alleged' revenue, and access prices are observations from monitored underground forums.

56431f3e820e255605aa40ba4927121fff1ddd50.summary: The German Federal Office for the Protection of the Constitution (BfV) warned that APT27, a Chinese cyberespionage group also known as Emissary Panda, has repeatedly attacked German companies since at least March 2021. The attacks exploited unpatched internet-exposed servers, using Microsoft Exchange and Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus flaws, to install the HyperBro malware for intelligence collection. The BfV said it cannot rule out supply chain attacks and published indicators of compromise. The report places this within a wider trend of Chinese hacking against large German companies.

5680c21a347bfdc57a46d79a2acb6749a0c88f0c.summary: Uptycs Threat Research reports a cryptomining campaign by the 8220 Gang, a Chinese-based group, from May 2023 to February 2024 against cloud infrastructure on Linux and Windows. The group scans for vulnerable applications and exploits flaws including CVE-2021-44228 and CVE-2022-26134. Windows infections use PowerShell, DLL sideloading and a UAC bypass. The Linux variant is a shell-script downloader that spreads over SSH and drops miners and the Tsunami IRCBot.
